historical_scope: 2026-01-02 through2026-10-05; prior warmup required. Same previously inspected year, not unseen validation.
source_to_implementation: These are explicit500-dollar adaptations of external ideas, not replications of source authors portfolios or returns.

funding.cash_availability: Only cash available under an explicit settlement ledger may fund another position; do not assume unlimited same-day recycling.

shared_execution.shares: whole integers; affordability chosen on last completed observed price; if next modeled execution becomes unaffordable, skip with no runner-up
shared_execution.cost_status: stress scenarios, not verified executable spread estimates; use actual quotes when available and disclose other fees
shared_execution.bar_time: America/New_York; bars are labeled by start time. Intraday entry signals consume completed one-minute bars, then wait one whole minute: bar09:35–09:36 completes at09:36, execution reference is09:37 open. Daily-close MA exits instead use next-session open as explicitly specified.
shared_execution.stops: Predeclared stop-market model active in the entry minute, not from the next minute only. Include entry-minute low after an opening entry. For later bars opening below stop, sale reference is the lower open minus costs; otherwise a stop touch uses stop minus costs. These OHLC assumptions do not prove executable fills, halts or gap liquidity. If EP entry open is already at/below its predeclared stop, stop the path as incomplete_gap_through_entry_stop, retain order/exposure ambiguity and require finer quotes; never credit an exit at a favorable stop above entry or assume a retroactive cancellation.
shared_execution.corporate_actions: Use improved split, dividend, symbol identity, receivable and missing-event accounting; preserve existing unresolved source currency/coverage flags
shared_execution.close_and_terminal: Use exchange calendar including early closes; mark open positions and keep censored final holdings rather than pretending sold.
shared_execution.scheduled_exits: Precommitted time exits use the last regular-session minute open (e.g.15:59 or12:59 for13:00 early close), with instructions known before that time; not a decision made after seeing its eventual close. Fixed10session EP exit uses this same schedule.

experiments.source: Zarattini/Barbon/Aziz ORB Stocks-in-Play; source academic evidence
experiments.rule: From broad cached asset universe, exclude currently verified ETFs/test issues; initial research pool remains non-PIT and must be labelled. Require opening price>5, previous14sessions average daily volume>=1000000, ATR14>0.50. At09:35 compute first5minutevolume/mean(previous14sessions first5minutevolume), require>=1. Rank top20 by this ratio. Long signals only if first5minute close>open. After09:35, first completed1minute close above initial5minute high forms signal until11:00; choose earliest signal, ties higherRV then symbol. One position/one entry per day. Initial stop entryprice-0.1*priorATR14; exit at the precommitted last regular-session minute open if not stopped.
experiments.atr_definition: Mean of prior14 true ranges, each max(high-low,abs(high-previousclose),abs(low-previousclose)) after point-of-decision split adjustments. Requires at least15 prior daily closes to compute14 true ranges. Simple mean smoothing is our fixed convention, not claimed verified identical to authors implementation.
